title: Class II food recall: PUMPKIN SPICE NO BAKE COOKIE NET WT 3.5 oz. INGREDIENTS:
summary: Peanuts & Eggs. The firm list peanuts in the ingredient statement but omitted them from the contain statement. They also have eggs listed in the contain statement but there are no eggs in the product.
place: Product was shipped to the following states: AL, FL, GA, IN, KY, MI, OH, TN, VA
